🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 25, 2026

Moon, in Aries, holds a trine to Jupiter, in Leo. Both in fire, and speaking the same dialect: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. It trines Saturn in Aries. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Fire starts and settles in the same breath. Unchanged for two weeks: you know what it asks.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Scorpio, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Four weeks of Scorpio ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Aries makes room for you, and then waits. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. Four weeks ago Mercury was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Aries. Sun in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. A week ago Moon was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you from Scorpio, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Moon trines you from Aries, meeting no resistance. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Aries, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Air opens the file, and the file has a price. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. Since Mars crossed out of Cancer, the question has changed.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Moon trines you from Aries, and the ease asks its own attention. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries and defends what needs no defending. Moon squares you from Aries: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal earth meets a bill. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Aries leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Air that holds on, holding without strain. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.
